_meta.description: Maps Grey Panda control identifiers to Maroon Elephant canonical ids (crosswalk keys). Grey Panda already cites OWASP ids (e.g. 'LLM01:2026'), so mapping is mostly normalization; on disagreement keep the union and tag each id with its source.

owasp_id_normalization._rule: Strip ':2026'/':2025' year suffix and whitespace; uppercase. 'LLM01:2026' -> 'LLM01'. 'ASI02' -> 'ASI02'.

consumed_finding_schema._note: Shape of each object in greypanda_scan_path(format=json).findings[]; adapter maps these fields into ME's finding model.
consumed_finding_schema.title: string
consumed_finding_schema.snippet: string (used with file to recompute ME fingerprint)
